caveats: This remains a robustness probe on the current counterfactual guard surface, not a promotion candidate for broad multilingual maintainer superiority.
The only observed movement versus Stage9883 is a tiny selection-loss improvement with no exact-match gain, which is not enough to support a stronger Gemma margin claim.
Because the confusion matrix is identical to Stage9883, the K collapse appears to be upstream of the strict split assignment rather than caused by the strict-anchor construction itself.
decision: The Stage9885 hybrid strict-anchor rerun is executable and contract-clean, but it is behaviorally identical to Stage9883 on exact accuracy, per-language cell exact, and confusion structure. The K-to-R collapse persists, so the strict-anchor swap does not improve the multilingual frontier.
